caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of six reinforcement learning configurations—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the benchmarks, with three distinct groups of bars for each. The vertical axis indicates accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks at 2% intervals. Each benchmark contains six grouped bars, with each group corresponding to one configuration. The bars are distinguished by color and pattern: solid blue for DAPO+Self-reflection, hatched blue for DAPO, solid orange for SRPO, hatched orange for GRPO, solid green for PPO+Self-reflection, and hatched green for PPO. The bars within each group are arranged in the order listed in the legend. In Mathverse, the SRPO bar is the tallest, followed by DAPO+Self-reflection, with the remaining configurations having lower and similar heights. In MMLU, GRPO has the highest bar, followed closely by DAPO+Self-reflection, while PPO has the lowest. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection has the highest bar, followed by SRPO, with PPO having the lowest among the six. The bars are not ordered by height within each group, and no additional visual emphasis such as shading or annotations is present.
